job_description:
Senior Mobile Software Developer 💰 Salary: $150,000 - 200,000 per year

At Hatch IT we are looking for a Mobile engineer!

🛠️ Our tech stack:
Android, Architect, Backbone, Backend, CI/CD, Cryptography, Fastlane, Jenkins, Mobile, MVVM, Security, Swift, TypeScript, iOS, microservices, UX UI Design

📝 Rquirements:
- Bachelors degree or higher in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
- Over 5 years of professional experience in developing and launching native mobile applications
- Proven expertise in both native iOS development (Swift) and native Android development
- Direct experience with native mobile security features, such as Secure Enclaves or similar secure storage methods
- Working knowledge of basic cryptography principles applicable to mobile security
- Strong background in integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs and managing asynchronous data streams
- Solid understanding of mobile UI/UX principles, architectural patterns (e.g., MVVM, MVI), and strategies for performance enhancement
- Experience with digital wallets, biometric authentication (Face ID/Touch ID), or comparable credential management systems is a major plus
- Familiarity with CI/CD processes for mobile app deployment (e.g., Fastlane, Jenkins, or equivalent)
- Proficiency in TypeScript for building and maintaining robust mobile applications

👩‍💻👨‍💻 Your responsibilities are:
- Drive the complete development, testing, and deployment of high-quality native applications for iOS (Swift) and Android
- Maintain application performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure broad compatibility across various devices and OS versions
- Architect and implement features that prioritize security and privacy, utilizing native mobile security frameworks
- Implement secure data management and storage, employing Secure Enclaves or equivalent technologies
- Apply fundamental cryptography principles for data protection and secure communication within the mobile context
- Integrate VIAs backend microservices and secure APIs into mobile application logic
- Act as a subject matter expert and provide technical leadership in mobile application development, ensuring VIAs solutions meet rigorous standards
- Clearly communicate complex software designs, architectural decisions, and technical processes to diverse audiences, including both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (UI/UX designers and backend developers) to ensure seamless, high-performing, and reliable application functionality
- Contribute to defining and maintaining mobile development best practices, code reviews, and automated testing
